question: What status does Windows 10 22H2 return for each public name in compat/reference/win10-22h2-syscalls.txt, and what does the ReactOS boot return for the same name?
allowedInputs: The Windows 10 22H2 x64 VMware VMDK was opened read-only by QEMU with -snapshot. No disk path was recorded. Captures stay under output/ and are not committed.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-getprocaddress The i386 probe calls the names in compat/reference/win10-22h2-syscalls.txt through GetProcAddress.
tools/windows-trace records a call number, a status, and a1 through a4, with no names and no ordinal map
Reported: the revised clean-room rule was reviewed before this work continued
